theorems.name: Submission.slicing_im_coarea_c1_approx
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (g : Eucl n → ℝ) (K : ℝ≥0), LipschitzWith K g → ∀ ε : ℝ≥0∞, 0 < ε → ∃ (A : Set (Eucl n)) (h : Eucl n → ℝ), IsClosed A ∧ (volume : Measure (Eucl n)) Aᶜ < ε ∧ ContDiff ℝ 1 h ∧ ∀ x ∈ A, g x = h x ∧ HasFDerivAt g (fderiv ℝ h x) x
